purpose: Response-blind continuation after K2R2: separate one-sided FULL capacity-existence evidence from the nonblocking FULL optimum-reference estimate, locally polish the two frozen R2 FULL endpoints with identical bounded derivative-free semantics, continue the exact frozen 128-skeleton fitter qualification, and only after fitter PASS continue the already-approved common burn-in, V2 partial-credit, evaluator-fidelity, lower-order and causal-calibration chain.

parent_k2r2.runtime_input_rule: read the authoritative completed K2R2 run in place through its marker; no K2R2 audit archive is a runtime input

capacity_evidence_semantics.full_claim: existence of at least one legal FULL calibration map satisfying the unchanged effect-size gates; no estimate of the global optimum is required for this one-sided claim
capacity_evidence_semantics.null_claim: coefficient-blind NULL capacity requires a qualified independent-launch reference because the claim is that NULL cannot obtain comparable improvement under the frozen calibration protocol
capacity_evidence_semantics.full_existence_witness_source: best F4 FULL record already present in the immutable K2R2 capacity-reference levels; calibration-only and forbidden from search
capacity_evidence_semantics.null_reference_source: highest executed K2R2 fidelity level with qualified NULL independent launches

full_optimum_polish.input_endpoints: the two immutable FULL R2 best F4 theta vectors from K2R2
full_optimum_polish.if_agreement_passes: freeze a stable calibration-only J_capacity reference using the lower of the two G65 polished scores
full_optimum_polish.if_agreement_fails: J_capacity and hard-decision R_att remain UNRESOLVED; main K2R3 continuation is not blocked

continuation_from_k2r2.common_burnin_protocol: byte-semantic reuse of p13_s0_k2r2_protocol.json common_burnin section
continuation_from_k2r2.residual_graft_protocol: byte-semantic reuse of p13_s0_k2r2_protocol.json residual_graft section
continuation_from_k2r2.evaluator_fidelity_protocol: reuse original K2 gate through K2R2 implementation
